description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository behaviors, specifically diagnosing issues related to out-of-scope pathspecs. It sets up repositories, runs commands, and checks expected outputs.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a test commit with specified files.

methods.name: git clone
methods.description: Clones a repository, with options for bare clone.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of test cases.
